FungsiKeterangan

💻 Kode – LED Blink
led_blink.ino
int ledPin = 13;

void setup() {
  pinMode(ledPin, OUTPUT);
}

void loop() {
  digitalWrite(ledPin, HIGH);
  delay(1000);
  digitalWrite(ledPin, LOW);
  delay(1000);
}
led_pwm_dimmer.ino
int ledPin = 9; // pin PWM ~

void setup() { pinMode(ledPin, OUTPUT); }

void loop() {
  // fade in
  for (int i=0; i<=255; i++) {
    analogWrite(ledPin, i);
    delay(8);
  }
  // fade out
  for (int i=255; i>=0; i--) {
    analogWrite(ledPin, i);
    delay(8);
  }
}

ldr_4pin_dual.ino
int doPin = 7;  // DO → digital
int aoPin = A0; // AO → analog

void setup() {
  Serial.begin(9600);
  pinMode(doPin, INPUT);
}
void loop() {
  int digital = digitalRead(doPin);
  int analog  = analogRead(aoPin);
  Serial.print("DO:"); Serial.print(digital);
  Serial.print(" AO:"); Serial.println(analog);
  delay(300);
}
💻 Kode – LED Otomatis (LDR)
ldr_led_otomatis.ino
int ldrPin = A0;
int ledPin = 13;
int threshold = 500;

void setup() {
  Serial.begin(9600);
  pinMode(ledPin, OUTPUT);
}

void loop() {
  int ldr = analogRead(ldrPin);
  Serial.print("LDR: ");
  Serial.println(ldr);

  if (ldr < threshold) {
    // Gelap → nyalakan LED
    digitalWrite(ledPin, HIGH);
  } else {
    // Terang → matikan LED
    digitalWrite(ledPin, LOW);
  }
  delay(200);
}

💡 Faktor /2 karena gelombang pergi + balik (2 arah)
💻 Kode – Ukur Jarak
hcsr04_jarak.ino
const int trigPin = 9;
const int echoPin = 10;

void setup() {
  Serial.begin(9600);
  pinMode(trigPin, OUTPUT);
  pinMode(echoPin, INPUT);
}

void loop() {
  // Kirim pulsa TRIG 10µs
  digitalWrite(trigPin, LOW);
  delayMicroseconds(2);
  digitalWrite(trigPin, HIGH);
  delayMicroseconds(10);
  digitalWrite(trigPin, LOW);

  // Baca durasi pantulan
  long durasi = pulseIn(echoPin, HIGH);

  // Hitung jarak
  float jarak = durasi * 0.034 / 2;

  Serial.print("Jarak: ");
  Serial.print(jarak);
  Serial.println(" cm");
  delay(500);
}

💻 Kode – Monitoring Suhu & Kelembaban
dht22_monitor.ino · Library: DHT sensor library (Adafruit)
#include <DHT.h>

#define DHTPIN   2
#define DHTTYPE  DHT22  // ganti DHT11 jika DHT11

DHT dht(DHTPIN, DHTTYPE);

void setup() {
  Serial.begin(9600);
  dht.begin();
}

void loop() {
  float h = dht.readHumidity();
  float t = dht.readTemperature(); // Celsius

  if (isnan(h) || isnan(t)) {
    Serial.println("Gagal baca sensor!");
    return;
  }

  Serial.print("Suhu: ");
  Serial.print(t);
  Serial.println(" C");

  Serial.print("Kelembaban: ");
  Serial.print(h);
  Serial.println(" %");

  delay(2000); // WAJIB minimal 2 detik
}

💻 Kode – Servo dengan Potensiometer
servo_potensiometer.ino
#include <Servo.h>

Servo myServo;
int potPin = A0;

void setup() {
  myServo.attach(9); // pin sinyal servo
  Serial.begin(9600);
}

void loop() {
  int pot = analogRead(potPin);
  // Map 0-1023 → 0-180 derajat
  int pos = map(pot, 0, 1023, 0, 180);
  myServo.write(pos);

  Serial.print("Posisi: ");
  Serial.println(pos);
  delay(15);
}
servo_sweep.ino
#include <Servo.h>
Servo myServo;

void setup() { myServo.attach(9); }

void loop() {
  for (int p=0; p<=180; p++) { myServo.write(p); delay(15); }
  for (int p=180; p>=0; p--) { myServo.write(p); delay(15); }
}

💻 Kode – LCD I2C & LCD tanpa I2C
lcd_i2c.ino · Library: LiquidCrystal_I2C
#include <Wire.h>
#include <LiquidCrystal_I2C.h>

// LiquidCrystal_I2C lcd(address, cols, rows)
LiquidCrystal_I2C lcd(0x27, 16, 2);

void setup() {
  lcd.init();
  lcd.backlight();
  lcd.setCursor(0, 0);  // col=0, row=0
  lcd.print("Hello World!");
  lcd.setCursor(0, 1);  // baris kedua
  lcd.print("Arduino I2C");
}
void loop() {}

💻 Kode – Scan & Connect WiFi
scan_wifi.ino (Jobsheet 8 – Program #1)
#include <WiFi.h>

void setup() {
  Serial.begin(115200);
  WiFi.mode(WIFI_STA);
}

void loop() {
  Serial.println("Scan Wifi...");
  int networks = WiFi.scanNetworks();

  if (networks == 0) {
    Serial.println("No WiFi Networks!");
  } else {
    Serial.print(networks);
    Serial.println(" Networks Found!");
    for (int i=0; i<networks; i++) {
      Serial.print("WiFi ke-"); Serial.println(i+1);
      Serial.println(WiFi.SSID(i));
      Serial.println(WiFi.RSSI(i));
      delay(10);
    }
  }
}
connect_wifi.ino
#include <WiFi.h>
const char* ssid     = "NamaWiFi";
const char* password = "PasswordWiFi";

void setup() {
  Serial.begin(115200);
  WiFi.begin(ssid, password);
  while (WiFi.status() != WL_CONNECTED) {
    delay(500); Serial.print(".");
  }
  Serial.print("\nIP: ");
  Serial.println(WiFi.localIP());
}
void loop() {}

dht_lcd.ino
#include <DHT.h>
#include <Wire.h>
#include <LiquidCrystal_I2C.h>

DHT dht(2, DHT22);
LiquidCrystal_I2C lcd(0x27, 16, 2);

void setup() {
  dht.begin();
  lcd.init(); lcd.backlight();
}

void loop() {
  float t = dht.readTemperature();
  float h = dht.readHumidity();
  if (isnan(t) || isnan(h)) return;

  lcd.clear();
  lcd.setCursor(0,0);
  lcd.print("Suhu: "); lcd.print(t); lcd.print("C");
  lcd.setCursor(0,1);
  lcd.print("Humid: "); lcd.print(h); lcd.print("%");
  delay(2000);
}

💻 Kode Gabungan
dht_servo.ino
#include <DHT.h>
#include <Servo.h>

DHT dht(2, DHT22);
Servo myServo;

void setup() {
  Serial.begin(9600);
  dht.begin();
  myServo.attach(9);
}

void loop() {
  float t = dht.readTemperature();
  if (isnan(t)) return;

  // Map suhu 0–50°C → 0–180 derajat
  int pos = map((int)t, 0, 50, 0, 180);
  pos = constrain(pos, 0, 180);
  myServo.write(pos);

  Serial.print("Suhu: "); Serial.print(t);
  Serial.print(" → Servo: "); Serial.println(pos);
  delay(2000);
}

#include <Servo.h>
Servo myServo;

void setup() {
  pinMode(13, OUTPUT);
  myServo.attach(9);
}
void loop() {
  int ldr = analogRead(A0);
  if (ldr < 500) {
    digitalWrite(13, HIGH);
    myServo.write(90);
  } else {
    digitalWrite(13, LOW);
    myServo.write(0);
  }
  delay(200);
}

parkir_sensor.ino
const int trig=9, echo=10;
const int lHijau=4, lKuning=5, lMerah=6;

void setup() {
  pinMode(trig, OUTPUT);
  pinMode(echo, INPUT);
  pinMode(lHijau, OUTPUT);
  pinMode(lKuning, OUTPUT);
  pinMode(lMerah, OUTPUT);
}
void loop() {
  digitalWrite(trig, LOW); delayMicroseconds(2);
  digitalWrite(trig, HIGH); delayMicroseconds(10);
  digitalWrite(trig, LOW);
  float j = pulseIn(echo,HIGH)*0.034/2;

  digitalWrite(lHijau,  j > 30);
  digitalWrite(lKuning, j>=10 && j<=30);
  digitalWrite(lMerah,  j < 10);
  delay(300);
}
🌡️ + 🖥️ + 💡 DHT + LCD + LED 3 Warna (Tugas Jobsheet 5)
Kode Lengkap Tugas JS5 Tugas Wajib
dht_led_3warna.ino · Suhu ≤25→Hijau | ≤35→Kuning | ≥36→Merah
#include <DHT.h>
#include <Wire.h>
#include <LiquidCrystal_I2C.h>

DHT dht(2, DHT11);
LiquidCrystal_I2C lcd(0x27, 16, 2);

const int ledHijau  = 4;
const int ledKuning = 5;
const int ledMerah  = 6;

void setup() {
  Serial.begin(9600);
  dht.begin();
  lcd.init(); lcd.backlight();
  pinMode(ledHijau,  OUTPUT);
  pinMode(ledKuning, OUTPUT);
  pinMode(ledMerah,  OUTPUT);
}

void loop() {
  float t = dht.readTemperature();
  float h = dht.readHumidity();
  if (isnan(t) || isnan(h)) { delay(2000); return; }

  // Tampil di LCD
  lcd.clear();
  lcd.setCursor(0,0);
  lcd.print("T:"); lcd.print(t); lcd.print("C H:"); lcd.print(h); lcd.print("%");

  // Matikan semua LED dulu
  digitalWrite(ledHijau,  LOW);
  digitalWrite(ledKuning, LOW);
  digitalWrite(ledMerah,  LOW);

  if (t <= 25) {
    digitalWrite(ledHijau, HIGH);
    lcd.setCursor(0,1); lcd.print("NORMAL :)");
  } else if (t <= 35) {
    digitalWrite(ledKuning, HIGH);
    lcd.setCursor(0,1); lcd.print("HANGAT!");
  } else {
    digitalWrite(ledMerah, HIGH);
    lcd.setCursor(0,1); lcd.print("PANAS! >>36C");
  }
  delay(2000);
}
🔧 Troubleshooting Cepat
MasalahSolusi
LCD kosong, backlight nyalaPutar potensio contrast di belakang modul I2C; atau coba address 0x3F
DHT baca NaNCek wiring, tunggu 2 detik antar baca, pastikan DHTTYPE benar
Servo bergetar/tidak stabilGunakan power supply terpisah untuk servo besar
HC-SR04 nilai 0 / errorPastikan TRIG=OUTPUT & ECHO=INPUT, benda dalam range 2–400 cm
Upload gagalInstall driver CH340/CP210x, gunakan kabel USB data (bukan charging only)
WiFi tidak konekPastikan 2.4GHz (bukan 5GHz), SSID/password benar, baud rate 115200
Library not foundSketch → Include Library → Manage Libraries → install
isnan() terus returnCek kabel DATA DHT, tambah delay(2000) sebelum baca pertama
